model: Mover Industrial Tricycle E-M2020-3CB Lightning Electric
description:
It's ELECTRIC!! The global standard in heavy duty industrial trikes, with 20 inch wheels and a THREE SPEED coaster brake.

It's Electric! Pedal or Power. Now More Powerful than ever with the standard 800W Electric Wheel. 3 Speed Mover Industrial Tricycle w/ 20" Wheels all around, front wheel has integrated electric drive systems. Front Disc and rear 3 speed coaster brake. Worksman Cycles has partnered with two overseas suppliers to create the ultimate electric front hub drive system. The Worksman Lightning E Kit. Featuring a comprehensive color LED dashboard, 48V Lithium Ion Battery with integrated LED Taillight, easy to use throttle and reverse function and powerful drive system. Includes easy to use charger. Now standard with Front Head Light Now all Worksman E-Cycles come with Hi Quality UL certified standard UL2271 Batteries featuring Samsung(tm) Cells and UL certrified Chargers and UL2849 certified E System 9 All Movers are rated at 550 Pounds overall weight capacity.Overall Width 33.75" . Another Classic from America's Oldest Cycle Manufacturer. Worksman Mover(tm) Tricycles are proudly Made in theConway SC USA using domestic and imported compoenets. Ships Via Truck 85% assembled.
